(4) [Subtitle]: 你在那邊受到的那種所謂的公眾人物的壓力. (5) [Subtitle]: 是不是會相對比較少?. (6) [Subtitle]: 其實我每次回台灣的時候 跟你走在街上. (7) [Subtitle]: 然後比如說被粉絲認出來 其實被認出來很開心. (8) [Subtitle]: 可是我同時對你有個疑問 就是說 你真的在台灣的時候少了自己的生活 少了自己的隱私. (13) [Subtitle]: 而且做的事情 我覺得是很有意義的 所以就算少了隱私 我也覺得 這就是我們的選擇. (14) [Logo]: Insta360.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video captures a sincere discussion between the members of the YouTube channel 'The DoDoMen' about the reality of being public figures. They contrast the relative anonymity one feels in the US with the pressure and lack of privacy in Taiwan. The conversation evolves into a deep reflection on whether the meaningful impact of their work justifies the personal sacrifices, ultimately affirming their choice to continue their current path.
